_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

segments.text: Pig, big, pack, back. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Pig, big, pack, back.

native.hook: P أم B؟ شاهد حركة الفم!
native.caption: هل “pig” و“big” تبدوان متشابهتين؟ في P يخرج هواء بلا صوت من الشفتين، أما في B فيهتز الصوت. وكذلك “pack” و“back”. راقب فم المعلمة Ama ثم كرّر في لحظة الصمت. تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: P or B? Watch the mouth!
en.caption: Do “pig” and “big” sound alike to you? For P, air comes out of the lips without voice; for B, your voice vibrates. The same goes for “pack” and “back”. Watch Ama’s mouth, then say each word in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
